desc: Understand the problem: find shortest path from i to j whose edge label concatenation is a palindrome
Design algorithm: BFS on product graph, reverse BFS from accepting states
Identify accepting states: (u,u) for even length, (u,v) with edge u->v for odd length
Implement reverse BFS on product graph for even accepting states (u,u)
Implement reverse BFS on product graph for odd accepting states (u,v) with edge u->v
Combine results: for each (i,j), answer = min(2*d_even[i][j], 2*d_odd[i][j]+1), with -1 if both are INF
Optimize inner loops: precompute incoming edges per label, use efficient data structures (e.g., list of lists)
Test with sample inputs to verify correctness
Ensure output format matches problem statement (space-separated, newline per row)
